profile.headline: Software Engineer at Valve corporation
profile.summary: I am a low-level software developer and theatre artist interested in building new experiences from the ground up. While my background is originally in the performing arts, I have spent the last few years cultivating a passion for high performance systems design, and enjoy finding new ways to challenge assumptions and create truly new technology

positions.title: VR Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Creator and lead engineer of Oculus Air Link. Was the sole engineer for 13 months prior to release. 
•  Oculus Link: responsible for controllers and tracking. Made latency feel artificially small. Solved hard, dumb math problems to make HMD/controller movement feel 1:1 with native Quest.
• Part of the bringup teams for Oculus Quest/Oculus Go
• Co-author of glTF 1.0 (Khronos' 3D scene format) and the open-source FBX2GlTF convertor
• SDK Software engineer on Samsung Gear VR

positions.title: Lab Associate
positions.description:
• Finding better ways to accurately model movement of yarns and knit objects
• Made some contributions to JS library that produces knitting machine instruction code.  Wrote programs to generalize and parameterize common knit patterns.  Worked independently on a project to produce generative knit patterns.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, 15-410
positions.description: TA for 15-410, Operating System Design and Implementation.

positions.title: GPU Intern
positions.description:
• Interactive Media Group, GPU Software Performance team.  
• Worked on improving performance of Compute for Metal (the since-released high-performance graphics framework)

courses.name: Introduction to Network Security and Applied Cryptography
